theater: 荊州公安城與長江中游水寨

battle.name: 梁戚昕襲陳公安之戰
battle.theater: 荊州公安城與長江中游水寨
battle.brief: 開皇五年（585）七月，戚昕以西梁方面的舟師夜襲陳朝公安縣城與江岸水寨，攻城不克，焚掠而退，梁與陳在長江中游的角力就此顯形。卡面這件羅馬扭力弩砲並非戰場實物：它要說明的是，本役勝負不靠砲火，而靠舟師能否靠岸、城頭弩手能否封住江面。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 梁戚昕襲陳公安之戰發生在陳後主禎明元年（隋開皇五年，585）七月前後，是南朝陳與梁室一系在長江中游的一次短促接觸。交戰的一方是南陳：以建康為都的朝廷以鎮軍將軍、護軍將軍、州刺史與各州郡兵為骨幹，兵種分為步卒、射手、弩手與沿江舟師，荊州一線的防務由江陵、公安兩處縣城與江岸水寨分擔，軍糧由江陵向下游轉輸，徵發的材官與水軍多來自沿江州郡。另一方是梁室一系：西魏破江陵、梁室播遷之後，昭明太子後人蕭詧在江陵重建政權，史稱西梁或後梁，都江陵，先臣於北周，開皇年間又淪為隋的外藩，疆域不過數縣，與陳隔江相望，西面靠巴蜀，東面卻失去了公安這一段水路。率軍來襲的戚昕，陳、隋、南史三書所載互有出入：一說他是梁宗室之後、任西梁大將軍；一說他本為陳之將吏，因與陳主失和而奔梁；另有並存的第三說，指他並非西梁所遣，而是借梁的名號自行起兵。三說無法互證，可以確定的只有：開皇五年盛夏，長江中游忽然出現一支以戚昕為首、與梁西一界有關的舟師水軍，兵鋒直指陳的公安縣城與江岸水寨。
countriesEn: The raid on Chen's garrison at Gong'an took place in the seventh month of the first year of Zhenming, that is the fifth year of Kaihuang, in 585, and was a brief contact between the Chen court of the south and a force connected with the surviving Liang house along the middle Yangtze. On one side stood southern Chen: the government at Jiankang still organised its field forces around generals of the defensive and protective commands, provincial governors and the troops of the individual commanderies, dividing them into infantry, archers, crossbowmen and river craft; the defence of the Jingzhou line was shared by the county seats of Jiangling and Gong'an together with the timber stockades on the river bank, military grain was shifted downstream from Jiangling, and the material-officer and water soldiers were levied from the provinces along the river. On the other side stood the Liang line: after the Western Wei broke Jiangling and the Liang house was scattered, Xiao Cha, a descendant of Crown Prince Xiao Tong, rebuilt a state at Jiangling, known as Western Liang or Later Liang, with Jiangling as its capital. He first submitted to Northern Zhou, and in the Kaihuang years the state sank to the status of a vassal of Sui, its territory reduced to a handful of counties, facing Chen across the river, backed by Ba-Shu to the west yet robbed of the stretch of waterway at Gong'an to the east. The identity of Qi Xin, who led the assault, is given differently in the histories of Chen, of Sui and of the Nan Shi: one account makes him a descendant of the Liang imperial house serving as general of Western Liang; another makes him a Chen officer who had fled to Liang after falling out with the Chen ruler; a third surviving account holds that he was not sent by Western Liang at all but rose on his own under the banner of Liang. None of the three can be confirmed against the others. What can be established is this: in high summer of the fifth year of Kaihuang a river force under Qi Xin, tied to the Liang-western side of the river, appeared on the middle Yangtze and turned its weapons directly on the county seat of Gong'an and the river-bank stockades held by Chen.
people: 戚昕是本役唯一可以指名的主將，其餘參戰者多已無名。梁末喪亂之後，宗室諸人散處南北，蕭詧一支靠北周與陳的間隙在江陵立國，戚昕則被史家記在梁西一系的名下；開皇五年他起兵時，所部兵眾、船艦與攻城器械一概不載於史，僅有「襲公安」「不克而退」數語流傳，故其人其事多有附會。陳後主陳叔寶在位時已無初期整軍之志，禎明元年仍在長江沿岸大建寺塔、頒行寬恤之詔，江北則與隋隔江相持，荊州的守備多倚賴州郡兵與縣兵，警覺程度有限。開皇五年，隋文帝楊堅在北方的整合已近完成，謀主高熲在此年獻上平陳之策，著重指出陳之精兵多聚荊楚、宜自襄漢與廣陵兩道夾擊，江防一旦被撬開，江南便無可守；隋並遣使沿江偵探地形水道。三年之後的行軍元帥楊素，也在開皇八年冬率舟師下三峽，先在狼尾灘擊破陳軍的守備，再直取江陵。姓氏相同的出現在開皇八年隋軍進軍的記載中，是否即為本役主將，諸說並存，難以斷定。
peopleEn: Qi Xin is the only commander of this action whose name survives; nearly all the other participants are nameless. After the collapse of Liang at the end of the dynasty, members of the imperial house were scattered across the north and the south, and Xiao Cha's line had survived through the gaps between Northern Zhou and Chen, founding a state at Jiangling, while Qi Xin is placed by the historians among the Liang-western party. When he rose in the fifth year of Kaihuang, the size of his force, the number of his vessels and his siege equipment are all unrecorded; only the phrases 'attacked Gong'an' and 'withdrew without success' have come down to us, so a good deal has been woven around that scant base. The Chen ruler Chen Shubao had by this time shown none of the will to refit the army that marked the early years of the dynasty; in the first year of Zhenming he was still raising Buddhist pagodas along the Yangtze and issuing lenient edicts, while north of the river Sui and Chen faced each other and the defence of Jingzhou rested on provincial and county troops whose vigilance was limited. In the fifth year of Kaihuang the reunification of the north under Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, was close to complete, and his adviser Gao Jiong presented his plan for the conquest of Chen in that very year, laying stress on the fact that Chen's best troops were massed in Jing and Chu and that the state should be struck simultaneously from the Xiangyang-Han route and from Guangling: once the river defences were prised open there would be nothing left to hold in the south. Sui also sent emissaries along the Yangtze to sound the terrain and the waterways. Three years later Yang Su, appointed commander of the expedition, came down the Three Gorges with a river fleet in the winter of the eighth year of Kaihuang, first breaking the Chen position at Langwei Shoal before moving straight on Jiangling. That a name of the same spelling appears among the Chen commanders of that later advance has been read by some as evidence that this is the same man, but the readings conflict and cannot be settled.
kits: 陳方可以確定的裝備，集中在弩、弓與舟師三樣。城頭與水寨以弩為主，強弩置於固定台位供齊射，小弩散給守城之卒；步卒配弓、槊與短兵，身著兜鍪與札甲，大盾以木為胎、蒙以皮革，踏陣前進時列在身前護住弩手。水寨則以木柵、連環與鐵索橫江為主，江面巡弋用蒙衝、斗艦與走舸，見於後來隋軍記載的五牙大艦、黃龍艦則是開皇年間新造的攻陳主力，本役時尚未出現。攻城一端沒有任何砲火：守方靠弓弩、擲石、擂木與火，攻方靠夜襲、鉤梯與焚燒水寨船隻。卡面這件羅馬弩砲並非戰場實物。Scorpio 是公元前一世紀羅馬的扭力弩砲，用絞盤拉緊的繩索與皮帶蓄能，一具一箭，箭重約半公斤上下、甚者近一公斤（諸說並存），射程多估在數百米（自一百五十米至三百五十米不等），既可架在攻城陣地前壓制城頭射手、掩護步卒貼牆，也曾置於軍艦前甲板，壓制對方甲板。杜佑《通典》所錄的「霹靂車」一類絞車拋射器械，學者多認為與羅馬扭力砲同出一譜，但那是八世紀的後世產物，與本役無涉。真正可以拿來對照的，是同一時期中國弩的機械原理：弩靠弓臂本身的彈性蓄能，不靠扭力，上弦全憑臂力或腰力，射程稍遜而射速遠勝，一具弓弩齊射的密度，是扭力弩砲每分鐘數發所望塵莫及的。
kitsEn: The equipment that can be securely attributed to the Chen side amounts to three things: the crossbow, the bow and the river fleet. On the walls and in the stockades the crossbow was the principal arm, heavy crossbows set in fixed emplacements for massed volleys and light crossbows distributed to the garrison soldiers; infantry carried bow, spear and short weapons under helmets and lamellar armour, while large shields of wood faced with hide were carried in front to cover the crossbowmen as the line advanced. The stockades were closed with timber palisades, chain and iron cable drawn across the water, and the craft that patrolled the river were ram-ships, fighting galleys and light skiffs; the great five-toothed ships and yellow-dragon vessels described in Sui's later records as the instruments of the assault on Chen were still new construction in the Kaihuang years and had not yet appeared in this action. On the attacking side there was no artillery fire of any kind: the defenders relied on bows and crossbows, stones cast by hand, beams dropped from above and fire, while the attackers relied on the night, on ladders and hooks, and on burning the boats in the stockade. The Roman ballista on the card face was not present in the field. The Scorpio is a torsion engine of the first century BC: a winch twisted cords and hide thongs to store the energy, one bolt per engine, the bolt weighing roughly half a kilogramme and in some cases close to a kilogramme (the figures vary), with a range usually reckoned at a few hundred metres, anywhere from a hundred and fifty to three hundred and fifty according to different estimates. It could be set up before a siege to pin the defenders on the walls and shelter the infantry as they closed on the masonry, and it was also mounted on the foredecks of warships to sweep the enemy's decks. The 'thunder-crash carriage' recorded in Du You's Tongdian, a class of winch-powered stone-thrower, is generally held by scholars to belong to the same technical family as the Roman torsion engine; but that is an eighth-century development and has nothing to do with this action. The proper comparison for the period is the principle of the Chinese crossbow: it stores its energy in the elasticity of the bow limbs rather than in torsion, the string is drawn by arm and back strength, its range a little shorter but its rate of fire far higher, and the density of a massed volley of bows and crossbows is something the one or two shots a minute of a torsion engine can never approach.
tactics: 戚昕的戰法只有一種可能：乘夜靠近。七月正值長江上游汛期，水位抬升、江面加寬，舟師趁夜溯流或順流而下，隱蔽在夜色與江霧裡貼近城岸，比白晝強攻的成功率高得多；登岸後以舟兵掩護步卒，或攀城牆，或用鉤索攀附，或火攻水寨泊船，趁守軍反應未及而登城。陳方的應對則是閉城門、發烽火，把弩手集中到城牆與水寨的一段，舉火照江面，以小舟與蒙衝撞擊靠岸的敵船，等其舟隊擠在一處、隊形被急流扯散時再行射擊；一旦強攻不成、守方弩矢密集，戚昕便只有退路。史載「不克而退」，說明整場攻擊時間不長，或許不過數日。對照卡面的羅馬弩砲，差距在這裡特別刺眼：羅馬攻城編制裡，扭力弩砲是壓制城頭的第一線，有了它，攻方才可以在箭雨之下護盾推進；本役的戚昕既無砲、又無攻城專用器械，只能靠奇襲與舟船的接近距離取勝，攻不成便無功而返。
tacticsEn: Qi Xin had only one method available: to close under cover of night. The seventh month falls in the flood season of the upper Yangtze, when the water rises and the river widens, and a fleet steaming up or down in darkness, hidden by the night and the river mist, had a far better chance of reaching the bank than an assault in daylight. Once alongside, the boat troops covered the soldiers as they landed, and the assault came either over the wall, or by hook and rope, or by fire against the boats moored in the stockade, hoping to mount the ramparts before the defenders had gathered. Chen's reply was to bar the gates, raise beacon fires, concentrate the crossbowmen on the section of wall and stockade facing the river, and light fires to pick out the water; light boats and ram-ships were sent to butt the enemy craft that came in, and the shooting opened once the hostile flotilla was bunched together and its formation torn apart by the current. When the frontal attack failed and the defenders' bolts came thick, Qi Xin had nothing but the way he had come. The record that he 'withdrew without success' shows that the whole attempt was brief, perhaps no more than a few days. Set against the Roman ballista of the card face, the gap is glaring. In a Roman siege order the torsion engine was the first line for pinning the wall, and only with it could the attacker advance behind the shields under a rain of arrows. Qi Xin had neither artillery nor purpose-built siege machines; he could win only by surprise and by the short range of his boats, and when the surprise failed he had to go home empty-handed.
data: 可以坐實的數字不多。時間在禎明元年（隋開皇五年）七月前後，具體日期無載。地理上，公安縣在荊州治所江陵西南約三十公里的長江北岸，隔江與松滋、澧州一帶相望，順流而下三十公里即到江陵；由三峽東口宜都到此約一百五十公里，舟師自上游來，須先過峽口這段最險的水路。兵力方面，陳、隋、南史都不記戚昕的部眾人數與船數，這不是漏記，而是當時本就無可據之數；從他只能夜襲、不能同時封鎖城垣與江面來推斷，其部當不足以形成合圍，也可能只靠數十艘舟船與數百至數千名舟兵。器械數字上，弩的有效射程多估在二百至三百米，弓約在一百至一百五十米；羅馬弩砲的射程諸說約一百五十至三百五十米，箭重約半公斤至一公斤，重新上弦需數人操作絞盤，一具一箭，射速遠低於弩。時間跨度上的對照數字較可靠：開皇五年高熲獻平陳策；開皇八年冬楊素舟師下三峽、夜破狼尾灘；開皇九年隋軍入建康，陳亡；同年隋括江陵戶口，記載約二十餘萬口，悉徙於北方（諸說並存）。
dataEn: Few numbers can be made solid. The time is the seventh month of the first year of Zhenming, the fifth year of Kaihuang, with no exact day recorded. Geographically, the county of Gong'an lay on the north bank of the Yangtze some thirty kilometres south-west of the Jingzhou seat at Jiangling, across the water from the Songzi and Lizhou districts, and thirty kilometres upstream of Jiangling; from the eastern mouth of the Three Gorges at Yidu it was about a hundred and fifty kilometres, so a fleet coming from above had first to pass the most dangerous water of the gorge. On strength, neither the histories of Chen nor of Sui nor the Nan Shi record the numbers of Qi Xin's men or of his boats, and this is not an omission but the simple fact that there was no reliable count to give; judging from the fact that he could only attempt a night raid and could never at once seal the wall and the river, his force cannot have been large enough to invest the place, and it may have amounted to no more than some dozens of craft carrying a few hundred to a few thousand boat soldiers. On the equipment, the effective range of the crossbow is commonly put at two hundred to three hundred metres and that of the bow at a hundred to a hundred and fifty; the Roman torsion engine is credited with a range variously given as a hundred and fifty to three hundred and fifty metres and a bolt of half a kilogramme to a kilogramme, with a new wind requiring several men at the winch and one bolt to the shot, a rate of fire far below that of the crossbow. The comparisons over time are the more reliable figures: in the fifth year of Kaihuang Gao Jiong presented his plan for the conquest of Chen; in the winter of the eighth year Yang Su brought his fleet down the Three Gorges and broke through at Langwei Shoal in the night; in the ninth year Sui troops entered Jiankang and Chen perished; and in that same year Sui drew up the household register of Jiangling, the record giving some two hundred thousand mouths, all of them moved north (the figures vary in the sources).
cause: 要理解這一場突然的襲擊，得把鏡頭拉回開皇五年的長江中游。隋取代北周之後，北方已定，遂有南伐之議，高熲在此年獻策，著重指陳之精兵多在荊楚、宜分兵自襄漢與廣陵兩道下手；隋亦遣使沿江偵探山川州縣與水道，為後來的水路進軍做準備。陳這邊則是典型的末世朝廷：後主怠於政事，大興佛寺塔、收括珍玩，江北防務全賴荊州的邊兵與水軍，而荊州上游的江陵與公安，正是陳與西梁爭奪最烈的一段界線——西梁都江陵，被陳的公安卡住西出與南下的水路，疆土日蹙，處處受制。戚昕的起兵，史料只說他以梁的名號發動，具體起因不詳：可能與他同西梁朝廷的嫌隙有關，可能是對西梁臣服於隋的不平，也可能只是趁陳邊防空虛的孤注一擲。諸說並存，無法坐實。近因則可指到汛期與部署：七月水漲，江面寬，舟兵可以隱蔽行進；隋在北方的整備又使各方都試圖先行試探江防，公安便成了試探的第一個目標。
causeEn: To understand this sudden raid the scene has to be pulled back to the middle Yangtze of the fifth year of Kaihuang. With Sui replacing Northern Zhou and the north settled, the question of a southern campaign was raised, and in that year Gao Jiong laid out his plan, stressing that Chen's elite troops were concentrated in Jing and Chu and that the state should be attacked simultaneously from the Xiangyang-Han route and from Guangling; Sui also sent emissaries down the river to survey the mountains, the prefectures, the counties and the waterways, preparing the waterborne advance that would come later. On the Chen side the picture is that of a late court: the ruler was absorbed in religion and luxury, raising pagodas and gathering treasures, and the northern defences rested entirely on the frontier troops and water soldiers of Jingzhou, while it was precisely the stretch of Jiangling and Gong'an in the upper Jingzhou that formed the sharpest disputed line between Chen and Western Liang. Western Liang had its capital at Jiangling but was held in check by Chen at Gong'an, squeezed on every side. The immediate reason for Qi Xin's rising is given only in the form that he acted in the name of Liang; the particulars are lost. It may have had to do with his quarrels with the court of Western Liang, it may have been resentment at that state's submission to Sui, or it may have been nothing more than a single desperate throw at a moment when Chen's frontier was thin. The readings stand side by side and none can be established. The proximate causes can be pointed to in the season and in the deployments: in the seventh month the water was up and the river wide, so a boat force could move unseen, and while the north was being prepared by Sui every side on the river was inclined to test the other's defences, which made Gong'an the first object of such a test.
impact: 就當時而言，戚昕失敗的意義是雙向的。對陳來說，公安城沒有丟，荊州上游的門戶仍在；但一次夜襲成功摸到城下，等於告訴陳朝：長江中游的防線是可以被摸到的。三年間的變化說明陳學到了教訓——開皇八年隋舟師下三峽時，陳軍已在江面拉起鐵索橫江，並在狼尾灘設灘防守，那是本役之後才出現的應對手段，也正是三年後隋軍要付出很大代價才拔掉的一道障礙。對西梁而言，這次用兵失敗加速了它的崩解：西梁本已是隋的外藩，戚昕一動，更暴露了江陵一帶對隋不滿的暗流，開皇年間隋平江陵時，西梁宗室相繼出降，數縣之地隨之併入隋版圖。對整個長江中游格局而言，本役是陳、西梁、北周（隋）三方競逐的一段縮影：到開皇九年，隋軍入建康，陳亡，江南盡入隋家，江陵一帶的士民被括徙北去，楚地三百年來第一次完全脫離南方王朝的掌握，改隸北朝。兵器史上的意義同樣不小：這是一個攻城砲火尚未普及的年代，陳的江防靠弩與舟，戚昕的攻擊靠奇襲與水運，攻不下便退，雙方都沒有把兵力投在破城上；羅馬式的扭力弩砲在那個世界裡還沒有位置，而它一旦出現並被北方新王朝用於改編水軍，江防的樣子就會完全改寫。
impactEn: In its own time the effect of Qi Xin's failure worked in two directions. For Chen the city of Gong'an was not lost and the upper gate of Jingzhou remained in its hands; but a night raid that succeeded in reaching the foot of the wall told the court that the line on the middle Yangtze could be touched. What happened in the three years that followed shows the lesson was learned: when Sui's fleet came down the Three Gorges in the eighth year of Kaihuang, the Chen had already stretched iron cable across the water and manned a shoal position at Langwei. Those were measures that appeared only after this action, and they were the obstacle that cost the Sui fleet dearly before it was broken. For Western Liang the failed expedition hastened its dissolution: the state was already a vassal of Sui, and the movement of Qi Xin laid bare the resentment at Jiangling towards the northern masters; when Sui struck at Jiangling in the Kaihuang years the Liang princely house surrendered in turn, and the handful of counties was absorbed into the Sui realm. For the whole middle-Yangtze order this campaign was a miniature of the three-way contest between Chen, Western Liang and Northern Zhou, soon to be Sui: in the ninth year of Kaihuang Sui troops entered Jiankang, Chen perished, the entire south passed to the Sui house, and the people of the Jingling region were counted out and moved north, so that for the first time in three centuries Chu territory passed wholly out of the hands of a southern dynasty and was administered by the north. The significance for the history of arms is equally clear. This was an age before siege artillery had become common: Chen's river defence rested on crossbows and boats, and Qi Xin's attack rested on surprise and river movement; neither side put troops into the business of breaking the wall, and when the assault failed the party withdrew. The Roman torsion engine had no place in that world, and once it appeared and was turned to rebuilding the war fleets of the new northern dynasty, the whole shape of the river defence would be rewritten.
result: 戚昕的襲擊沒有成功。史書對結果的記載只有「不克而退」四字：公安城未失，江岸水寨未破，陳的守軍把舟師擋在了城下，戚昕只有焚掠資財、退回江陵一帶。陳方的人員與器械損失沒有留下數字，這類邊境夜襲在編年史中往往只記勝負不記傷亡，不能因此認定雙方都毫髮無傷——舟船在江中被射、夜襲被察覺後的損失，多半已被省略。戚昕此後的結局同樣不明：他的名字在《隋書》等北方文獻中偶有出現，有人據此把開皇八年狼尾灘一役的陳將視為同一人，也有人認為是同姓而不同人，兩說並存無法裁決。放長遠看，本役在陳的國史上只是一段插曲：三年之後，隋行軍元帥楊素率舟師穿過三峽，在狼尾灘破陳軍的攔阻，江陵淪陷，陳的荊州防線崩解；翌年隋軍入建康，陳後主被擒，陳朝覆亡。戚昕在公安城下試探出的那條縫隙，最終被隋的舟師和更大規模的攻勢徹底撕開。
resultEn: Qi Xin's attack did not succeed. The histories record the outcome in four characters only: he 'withdrew without success'. The city of Gong'an was not taken, the river-bank stockade was not broken, and Chen's defenders held the fleet off at the foot of the wall; Qi Xin could do no more than burn and carry off what he could and fall back towards Jiangling. No figures survive for Chen's losses in men or material, and in a border raid of this kind the annalists habitually record the result and not the casualties, so it cannot be concluded that neither side came off unscathed: the loss of boats on the river under fire and the damage done to the raiders after the night movement was detected were for the most part left out. The later fate of Qi Xin is equally obscure. His name appears occasionally in northern documents such as the Book of Sui, and some have taken the Chen commander at Langwei Shoal in the eighth year of Kaihuang to be the same man, while others hold that he was a namesake rather than the same person; the two readings stand side by side and cannot be decided. In the longer view the episode is only an interlude in the history of Chen. Three years later Yang Su, commander of the Sui expedition, took his fleet through the Three Gorges, broke the Chen obstruction at Langwei Shoal and took Jiangling, collapsing the Jingzhou line of the Chen; in the following year the Sui army entered Jiankang, the last Chen emperor was taken, and the Chen state was extinguished. The seam that Qi Xin had probed at the foot of the walls of Gong'an was in the end torn wide open by the Sui fleets and by a far greater offensive.
